title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Image Upload in Copilot Chat for Government Cloud
description: The image upload feature in Microsoft 365 Copilot allows users to upload images and seek insights from Copilot based on those images. We are bringing this capability to Government Cloud environments, delivering parity with existing Copilot experiences while ensuring the functionality operates within applicable Government Cloud boundaries.
